opportunities.title: Convocatoria 56 - Convocatoria de emergencia para la recuperación y generación de capacidades transformadoras (Decreto 1414 de 2026)
opportunities.funder: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (MinCiencias), Colombia - Sistema General de Regalías (SGR) Asignación CTeI
opportunities.deadline_text: Cierre: martes 3 de noviembre de 2026, 4:00 pm (cronograma oficial). Resultados preliminares 1 dic 2026; definitivos 7 dic 2026.
opportunities.funding_text: 'se asigna un monto de $700.000.000.000 provenientes de los recursos del Sistema General de Regalías' ... 'Cada proyecto podrá solicitar hasta $14.000.000.000.' Se espera financiar 10 proyectos por línea temática.
opportunities.duration: Hasta 24 meses ('El término de la ejecución de los proyectos será de hasta veinticuatro (24) meses').
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Entidad proponente/ejecutora: IES, actores del SNCTI (con reconocimiento vigente), entidades territoriales o actores del sector productivo. Alianza mínima: al menos una IES + al menos una entidad territorial de un departamento afectado + al menos uno de: actor SNCTI reconocido, actor del sector productivo o organización de sociedad civil domiciliada en departamento afectado. Entidades internacionales pueden ser aliados.
opportunities.eligible_countries: Colombia (ejecución en 16 departamentos afectados: Antioquia, Bolívar, Caldas, Caquetá, Cauca, Chocó, Cundinamarca, Huila, Nariño, Norte de Santander, Quindío, Risaralda, Santander, Sucre, Tolima y Valle del Cauca).
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: CIAT/Alliance can join as an international ally ('entidades u organizaciones de carácter internacional, en calidad de aliados') with a 'Carta entidad internacional' specifying its in-kind/cash contribution in COP; international allies are not part of the governance model. CIAT could only be proponent/ejecutora if it holds valid MinCiencias recognition as an SNCTI actor (not verified). Most realistic: a Valle del Cauca/Cauca IES (e.g., Univalle, Univ. del Cauca, UNAL Palmira) leads; CIAT contributes EO/AI/crop-modelling and risk analytics.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Proponente/ejecutora must be an IES, recognized SNCTI actor, territorial entity, or productive-sector actor; must demonstrate direct link between emergency impacts and the CTeI gap.
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Execution only in the 16 departments covered by Decreto 1261/2026 (mod. 1348/2026); must show direct link to the emergency.
opportunities.consortium_details: Alianza estratégica mínima: IES + entidad territorial afectada + (actor SNCTI reconocido | sector productivo | sociedad civil domiciliada en departamento afectado). International entities may be added as allies.
opportunities.cofunding_details: International ally letter must state contribution 'ya sea en especie o en efectivo expresado en pesos colombianos'. General counterpart rules in TdR not fully reviewed.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Adapt, validate, transfer, appropriate or scale technologies/innovations for recovery. Lines: 5.1 risk management and regional security (early warning, monitoring, digital twins, predictive analytics, damage assessment); 5.2 sustainable reconstruction incl. environmental and agro-productive recovery; 5.3 social recovery incl. rural productive recovery and food security; 5.4 science-based companies; 5.5 knowledge ecosystems.
opportunities.required_documents: Per TdR (36 pp): project in SIGP, alliance letters, Carta entidad internacional (si aplica, in Spanish or English, signed by director of institute/centre/group), Anexo 12 talent hiring guidelines, among others.
opportunities.application_procedure: Online submission via SIGP (MinCiencias) per the TdR; projects become a bank of eligible projects for SGR CTeI financing.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Early warning, monitoring, digital twins, predictive analytics, damage assessment and agro-productive recovery map directly to EO/AI/crop-modelling capacities.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Large Colombian public funding (COP 14 bn/project) in Valle del Cauca and Cauca, CIAT's home region; strengthens national partnerships.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Science fits well, but only ~3 weeks to deadline and requires a national IES lead plus territorial entity buy-in; CIAT only as ally.
opportunities.recommendation: Pursue immediately as international ally to a Valle del Cauca/Cauca university consortium on EO-based damage assessment, early warning and agro-productive recovery. Verify if CIAT has SNCTI recognition that would allow a stronger role.
opportunities.potential_partners: Universidad del Valle, Universidad del Cauca, Universidad Nacional (Palmira), AGROSAVIA, Gobernación del Valle del Cauca / municipal governments, CVC, gremios (e.g., Asocaña, Fedearroz).
opportunities.next_action: Contact Valle/Cauca IES research offices this week; prepare Carta entidad internacional with in-kind contribution in COP; confirm CIAT SNCTI recognition status with MinCiencias.

opportunities.title: Convocatoria 53 - Fortalecimiento de capacidades de CTeI en el departamento de Córdoba (Plan bienal 2025-2026, corte 2)
opportunities.funder: MinCiencias, Colombia - Sistema General de Regalías (SGR)
opportunities.deadline_text: Cierre: viernes 23 de octubre de 2026, 4:00 p.m.
opportunities.funding_text: Recursos disponibles: COP $28.094.792.444,00 (total). Per-project cap not verified.
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Proponente: IES, entidad del sector productivo u organización de sociedad civil domiciliada en Córdoba, con al menos dos proyectos CTeI ejecutados en los últimos 5 años.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: International entities can participate with a 'Carta entidad internacional' (no NIT, no carta aval Anexo 1), registered in SIGP/Anexo 2, not part of governance. CIAT cannot be proponent (must be domiciled in Córdoba).
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Domiciled in Córdoba; adequate DNP performance if measured in last 2 years; >=2 CTeI projects executed in last 5 years.
opportunities.consortium_details: Alliance: >=1 IES headquartered in Córdoba; 2 territorial entities in Córdoba (one must be the Departamento); 1 productive-sector actor; 1 civil-society organization in Córdoba; at least one member with research group A1/A/B.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Agricultural, social and environmental reactivation; Reto 2 food sovereignty; Line 4 CTeI solutions for socioeconomic reactivation and mitigating extreme climate conditions; projects must address >=2 thematic lines.
opportunities.required_documents: Per TdR; Carta entidad internacional for international partners; Anexo 2 alliance registration; Anexo 4 territorial demands.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Climate extremes and food sovereignty in Córdoba fit climate-smart ag; RS/AI methods supportive rather than core.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Colombian public funding, but CIAT is a non-governing ally; Córdoba is outside core HQ region.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: 9 days to deadline and complex 5-member local alliance must already be formed.
opportunities.recommendation: Only pursue if an existing Córdoba consortium (e.g., Universidad de Córdoba, AGROSAVIA Turipaná) invites CIAT as international ally; otherwise skip.
opportunities.potential_partners: Universidad de Córdoba, AGROSAVIA C.I. Turipaná, Gobernación de Córdoba, CVS, local producer associations.
opportunities.next_action: Ask Universidad de Córdoba / AGROSAVIA contacts by 2026-10-16 whether a proposal needs an international EO/crop-modelling ally.

opportunities.title: SATREPS FY2027 (令和9年度) - Science and Technology Research Partnership for Sustainable Development
opportunities.funder: Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) with JICA
opportunities.program: SATREPS (Environment & Energy; Bioresources; Disaster Prevention). FY2027 includes 'Priority SATREPS' (重点推進型) for Africa, Latin America and Pacific Islands.
opportunities.deadline_text: Application Period: Aug. 18, 2026 - Oct. 19, 2026 at 12:00 noon (Japan Time). ODA request from partner government to Japan MOFA: 令和8年10月13日（火）中【厳守】.
opportunities.funding_text: About ¥100 million per project per year total; JST ~¥35 million/yr (incl. indirect), max ¥175 million over 5 years; JICA ODA technical cooperation up to ¥300 million over 5 years.
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Japanese PI at a research institution in Japan (国内の研究機関) submits via e-Rad; partner-country institution must have its government submit an ODA request via the Japanese embassy.
opportunities.eligible_countries: ODA-eligible countries listed in 別添1; Colombia (コロンビア共和国) is listed. Max 12 requests per country this year.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Q&A: regional international organizations in a developing country are not excluded, but the partner government must approve their ODA implementation, submit the ODA request, a government-to-government international agreement is required, and the organization must secure its own personnel and costs. Realistic route: Japanese PI (e.g., Univ. of Tokyo contacts) + Colombian national counterpart (AGROSAVIA/university) with CIAT as participating institution.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Japanese PI at a Japanese institution; partner-country counterpart PI capable of leading the partner implementation structure.
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Partner countries per Annex 1 (Colombia included); priority regions Africa, Latin America, Pacific Islands.
opportunities.consortium_details: Japan-partner country joint research under JICA technical cooperation project; multi-country proposals possible only if all governments submit ODA requests by deadline.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Joint research addressing global issues with ODA impact; capacity building; equipment; researcher exchange (JICA experts/trainees).
opportunities.required_documents: Forms 1-9 (yoshiki2027.docx), outcome target sheet (PPTX), e-Rad submission; partner-country ODA request.
opportunities.application_procedure: Japanese PI submits via e-Rad by Oct 19, 2026 noon JST; partner country submits ODA request through MOFA/embassy by Oct 13, 2026.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Bioresources / environment fields fit plant phenotyping, RS, crop modelling and climate adaptation; researcher has Univ. of Tokyo PhD ties.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Latin America is a FY2027 priority region; large 5-year budget; strong Japan-Colombia partnership potential.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: ODA request deadline (Oct 13) already passed; unless a Japanese PI already filed with a Colombian ODA request, FY2027 is not achievable. Feasible for FY2028 with ~12 months preparation.
opportunities.recommendation: For FY2027: only check whether any Japanese team already filed a Colombia ODA request that could include CIAT. Main value: start FY2028 preparation now (Japanese PI, Colombian counterpart, APC Colombia ODA request).
opportunities.potential_partners: University of Tokyo (former lab), JIRCAS, AGROSAVIA, Universidad Nacional de Colombia, APC-Colombia (ODA focal point), JICA Colombia office.
opportunities.next_action: Email Univ. of Tokyo contacts about a FY2028 SATREPS concept; contact APC-Colombia on the ODA request timeline (FY2027 request was due 2026-10-13).

opportunities.program: Invitational Fellowships for Research in Japan
opportunities.deadline_text: 2nd recruitment (Short-term only): application deadline (host institution to JSPS) April 23, 2027, 5 p.m. JST; arrival Oct 1, 2027 - Mar 31, 2028. (1st recruitment closed Aug 28, 2026.)

opportunities.application_procedure: Host submits via JSPS Electronic Application System (opens ~2 months before deadline) through their institution.

opportunities.funding_text: Phase 1: up to US$12,500 for one year per researcher/mission costs; Phase 2 up to additional US$12,500; Phase 3 up to US$25,000 (requires partner co-financing). Up to 30 proposals per edition.

opportunities.consortium_details: SP researcher + exactly one foreign partner institution.
opportunities.cofunding_details: Partner side covers its own mission costs; Phase 3 requires partner co-financing.
